requirement.description: The Layout.const method doesn't properly handle None values for struct layouts, causing a TypeError when trying to initialize with None.
requirement.contract: When Layout.const() is called with init=None for StructLayout, it should return a constant with value 0 and the appropriate size, instead of raising a TypeError.

requirement.description: The Layout.const method raises a TypeError with incorrect error message for non-mapping/sequence values, instead of a more descriptive message.
requirement.contract: When Layout.const() is called with a scalar value (not a mapping or sequence), it should raise a TypeError with message "Layout constant initializer must be a mapping or a sequence, not <type>"

requirement.description: ArrayLayout.__getitem__ raises TypeError with wrong message for non-integer keys.
requirement.contract: When accessing ArrayLayout with a non-integer key, it should raise TypeError with message "Cannot index array layout with <type>"

requirement.description: Signal reset validation doesn't properly validate enum reset values, causing TypeError with wrong message.
requirement.contract: When Signal is initialized with an enum shape and reset value that isn't a valid enum member, it should raise TypeError with message "Reset value must be a constant initializer of <enum_type>"

requirement.description: Enum.const method doesn't handle integer values correctly, causing TypeError when casting to constant.
requirement.contract: When Enum.const() is called with an integer value, it should properly convert it to a constant with the appropriate shape, instead of raising TypeError.
